cards.name: Quick Peek
cards.description: Briefly challenge an angle to gather information and potentially tag an opponent.

cards.name: Double Peek
cards.description: Two attackers challenge the same angle together, making it harder for the defender to isolate one player.

cards.name: Contact Push
cards.description: Attackers move quietly and only commit when they reach close range.

cards.name: Lane Pressure
cards.description: Apply pressure to one lane without fully committing to the site.

cards.name: Utility Clear
cards.description: Use basic utility to force an opponent away from a common position.

cards.name: Choke Pressure
cards.description: Occupy an important entrance and force defenders to give up space.

cards.name: Slow Advance
cards.description: Gradually take territory while checking positions.

cards.name: Angle Isolation
cards.description: Use positioning or utility to reduce the number of angles that must be checked.

cards.name: Fake Pressure
cards.description: Make enough noise/utility to suggest an attack without fully committing.

cards.name: Probe Attack
cards.description: Small initial attack designed primarily to discover the defensive setup.

cards.name: Controlled Entry
cards.description: Enter slowly with teammates covering different angles.

cards.name: Side Pressure
cards.description: Pressure a secondary route to make the defense uncomfortable.

cards.name: Early Map Control
cards.description: Secure a small area before attempting the main attack.

cards.name: Corner Clear
cards.description: Systematically clear common hiding positions.

cards.name: Retreat-and-Reattack
cards.description: Make a small commitment, withdraw, then attack again from another timing.

cards.name: Flash Entry
cards.description: Use a blinding effect or distraction before entering an area.

cards.name: Smoke Entry
cards.description: Block important defensive sightlines before pushing.

cards.name: Stun Entry
cards.description: Disrupt defenders before attempting to take their position.

cards.name: Recon Push
cards.description: Gather information immediately before committing to the attack.

cards.name: Utility Combo
cards.description: Combine two pieces of utility to make the entry harder to stop.

cards.name: Two-Lane Push
cards.description: Attack through two nearby routes simultaneously.

cards.name: Delayed Push
cards.description: One group enters first while another group waits for the right timing.

cards.name: Split Pressure
cards.description: Attackers divide their pressure between two routes.

cards.name: Mid Pressure
cards.description: Control the central route to threaten multiple areas.

cards.name: Rotation Bait
cards.description: Create pressure on one side to encourage defenders to rotate away.

cards.name: Fake Execute
cards.description: Use substantial utility but intentionally delay the actual commitment.

cards.name: Site Isolation
cards.description: Block defensive sightlines and isolate part of the site.

cards.name: Crossfire Break
cards.description: Coordinate movement specifically to break a defensive crossfire.

cards.name: Lurk Pressure
cards.description: One player quietly pressures another area while the team creates noise elsewhere.

cards.name: Timing Push
cards.description: Wait for defensive utility or abilities to expire before committing.

cards.name: Full Site Execute
cards.description: Team commits together with coordinated utility and positioning.

cards.name: Three-Lane Execute
cards.description: Apply simultaneous pressure from three routes.

cards.name: A-Split Style Execute
cards.description: One group attacks from the main route while another attacks from a secondary route.

cards.name: B-Split Style Execute
cards.description: Same concept as a split attack directed toward another objective area.

cards.name: Mid-to-Site Split
cards.description: Gain central control and use it to attack the site from multiple directions.

cards.name: Flash-Smoke Execute
cards.description: Combine vision denial and disruption before entering.

cards.name: Recon-Flash Execute
cards.description: Locate defenders and immediately disrupt their positions.

cards.name: Stun-Smoke Execute
cards.description: Reduce defender effectiveness while blocking their vision.

cards.name: Delayed Split
cards.description: Start an attack from one side, then introduce the second attack at an unexpected moment.

cards.name: Contact Execute
cards.description: Minimize early noise before suddenly committing as a group.

cards.name: Rotation Trap
cards.description: Force defenders to rotate and then attack the space they abandoned.

cards.name: Double Fake
cards.description: Threaten two locations before committing to the actual target.

cards.name: Lurk + Execute
cards.description: A hidden attacker creates pressure behind the expected defensive setup.

cards.name: Utility Drain
cards.description: Repeatedly pressure defenders until their defensive resources are reduced.

cards.name: Late Execute
cards.description: Hold the attack until defenders have fewer resources and less time to respond.

cards.name: Full-Team Rush
cards.description: Almost the entire attacking team commits rapidly toward one objective.

cards.name: Perfect Split
cards.description: Coordinated groups attack from multiple directions at nearly the same time.

cards.name: Triple-Side Execute
cards.description: Pressure arrives from three separate directions simultaneously.

cards.name: Full Utility Execute
cards.description: The team spends a large portion of its resources to overwhelm the defense.

cards.name: Multi-Fake Execute
cards.description: Several false threats are created before the actual attack.

cards.name: Rotation Punish
cards.description: Attackers deliberately manipulate defender rotations and immediately exploit the weak area.

cards.name: Perfect Timing Attack
cards.description: Attack begins exactly when defensive resources are unavailable or recovering.

cards.name: Information Overload
cards.description: Multiple simultaneous threats make it difficult for defenders to determine the real attack.

cards.name: Lurk + Triple Push
cards.description: A hidden player combines with a coordinated multi-route attack.

cards.name: Resource Exhaustion Execute
cards.description: Attackers deliberately drain defensive resources before making the final commitment.

cards.name: Adaptive Execute
cards.description: Attack begins with one plan but changes immediately based on defensive reactions.

cards.name: Full Map Pressure
cards.description: Attackers threaten multiple areas simultaneously, forcing the defense to spread out.

cards.name: Counter-Rotation Attack
cards.description: Attackers deliberately wait for defensive movement and attack during the rotation.

cards.name: Timed Final Execute
cards.description: A carefully coordinated final push uses timing, positioning and remaining resources together.

cards.name: Master Execute
cards.description: A highly coordinated combination of split pressure, utility, timing and deception.

cards.name: Basic Hold
cards.description: Stay in position and defend the expected entrance.

cards.name: Angle Hold
cards.description: Maintain an advantageous angle against approaching attackers.

cards.name: Double Hold
cards.description: Two defenders cover the same important area.

cards.name: Passive Hold
cards.description: Avoid unnecessary fights and preserve position.

cards.name: Choke Hold
cards.description: Defend an important entrance into the area.

cards.name: Early Information
cards.description: Gather information before the attackers commit.

cards.name: Position Change
cards.description: Change position after being spotted to avoid being predictable.

cards.name: Close Defense
cards.description: Hold a position where attackers must get close before challenging.

cards.name: Long Defense
cards.description: Maintain distance and make the attackers cross open space.

cards.name: Basic Retreat
cards.description: Give up some space rather than taking an unfavorable fight.

cards.name: Utility Stall
cards.description: Use a small amount of utility to slow the attack.

cards.name: Crossfire Setup
cards.description: Two defenders cover each other from different angles.

cards.name: Trap Position
cards.description: Place a defender or defensive resource where attackers are likely to enter.

cards.name: Flank Watch
cards.description: Keep one player watching for attackers coming from behind.

cards.name: Reposition Defense
cards.description: Move to a different defensive location after detecting pressure.

cards.name: Defensive Smoke
cards.description: Block an attacking route and delay their advance.

cards.name: Flash Retardation
cards.description: Disrupt attackers as they attempt to enter.

cards.name: Stun Defense
cards.description: Reduce attacking effectiveness before they reach the objective.

cards.name: Recon Defense
cards.description: Gather information about the attacking formation.

cards.name: Utility Combination
cards.description: Combine multiple defensive resources to stop an entry.

cards.name: Crossfire Defense
cards.description: Coordinate two or more defenders to punish an entry.

cards.name: Choke Stall
cards.description: Repeatedly delay attackers at an important entrance.

cards.name: Early Rotation
cards.description: Move defensive resources toward the threatened area quickly.

cards.name: Controlled Retreat
cards.description: Give up the first area while preparing a stronger second position.

cards.name: Anti-Rush Setup
cards.description: Specifically prepare for a fast coordinated attack.

cards.name: Fake Rotation
cards.description: Appear to rotate while secretly maintaining defensive coverage.

cards.name: Information Trap
cards.description: Allow limited enemy movement to learn their actual plan.

cards.name: Mid Control
cards.description: Maintain control over the central route to restrict attacker movement.

cards.name: Lurk Detection
cards.description: Position resources specifically to detect hidden attackers.

cards.name: Timing Defense
cards.description: Save defensive resources until the attacker's commitment is clear.

cards.name: Full Site Hold
cards.description: Multiple defenders coordinate to protect the objective directly.

cards.name: Layered Defense
cards.description: Defenders create several defensive positions that attackers must break through.

cards.name: Three-Point Defense
cards.description: Defenders cover three important approaches simultaneously.

cards.name: Split Defense
cards.description: Defensive players divide between the main objective and secondary threat.

cards.name: Mid-Control Defense
cards.description: Maintain central control while still protecting the objective.

cards.name: Utility Retake
cards.description: Allow limited entry and then use coordinated utility to reclaim the area.

cards.name: Crossfire Network
cards.description: Several defenders create overlapping lines of support.

cards.name: Delayed Retake
cards.description: Avoid immediately committing and wait for teammates before reclaiming.

cards.name: Rotation Trap
cards.description: Attackers are allowed to commit while defenders prepare to punish their positioning.

cards.name: Anti-Split Defense
cards.description: Defensive positioning specifically covers multiple simultaneous entrances.

cards.name: Resource Conservation
cards.description: Save important defensive resources for the final stage of the attack.

cards.name: Information Network
cards.description: Multiple information sources continuously track attacker movement.

cards.name: Flank Containment
cards.description: Prevent hidden attackers from creating an unexpected secondary threat.

cards.name: Retake Formation
cards.description: Several defenders coordinate their positions before attempting to retake.

cards.name: Adaptive Defense
cards.description: Defensive formation changes according to the attacker's choices.

cards.name: Full Anti-Rush
cards.description: Entire defense is prepared for an immediate coordinated attack.

cards.name: Perfect Crossfire
cards.description: Multiple defenders create extremely strong overlapping coverage.

cards.name: Multi-Layer Defense
cards.description: Attackers must overcome several defensive layers before reaching the objective.

cards.name: Triple-Site Coverage
cards.description: Defense simultaneously protects three important approaches.

cards.name: Full Utility Defense
cards.description: Large amounts of defensive resources are coordinated to stop the attack.

cards.name: Rotation Punish
cards.description: Defenders deliberately allow a predictable commitment and then respond from advantageous positions.

cards.name: Perfect Retake
cards.description: Defenders coordinate timing, positioning and utility for a unified retake.

cards.name: Information Lockdown
cards.description: Defenders maintain extremely strong awareness of attacker movement.

cards.name: Anti-Lurk Network
cards.description: Defensive positions specifically prevent hidden attackers from influencing the round.

cards.name: Resource Denial
cards.description: Defenders preserve key resources specifically to counter the final attack.

cards.name: Adaptive Fortress
cards.description: Defensive setup constantly changes based on the attacker's behavior.

cards.name: Multi-Route Counter
cards.description: Defense simultaneously responds to attacks from multiple directions.

cards.name: Counter-Rotation
cards.description: Defenders deliberately manipulate their positioning to punish attacking rotations.

cards.name: Timed Retake
cards.description: The defense waits for the optimal moment and then executes a coordinated retake.

cards.name: Master Defense
cards.description: A highly coordinated combination of information, positioning, utility, timing and adaptation.
